sentence: This project tries to find out which proteins interact with ankyrin-B, a protein made from a high confidence autism gene, at the postsynaptic side.
This project studies how neural networks in adults and adolescents guide motivated behaviors differently, and how those differences relate to each other.
This project builds computational and statistical methods that use machine learning scores for pathogenic genetic variants to estimate disease risk.
This project examines how flavoring chemicals inhaled during e-cigarette use affect the function of mouse and human heart cells and tissues.
This project studies a treatment strategy for hepatocellular carcinoma that uses an image-guided device to deliver immunotherapy and hyperthermia.
This project tries to find out which molecular events cause diabetic neuropathic pain, focusing on a stress signaling pathway that regulates nociceptor excitability.
This project studies the computational principles and neural mechanisms of mental simulation, the ability to simulate structural relationships in the environment.
This project builds and adapts microscope imaging methods to address open questions about kidney function and dysfunction.
This project studies how phosphorylation changes the way adult and fetal forms of the Tau protein work and fail in Alzheimer's disease.
This project studies how a tumor phospholipase keeps T cells out of tumors in non-small cell lung cancer and whether targeting it could help treatment.
This project builds a personalized, 3D bioprinted nipple areolar complex implant for breast reconstruction after mastectomy.
This project studies how transporters, molecular machines that move substances in and out of cells, work, using a family of neurotransmitter transporters.
This project studies how exposure to multiple contaminants affects neurodevelopmental health and builds remediation and treatment strategies for these co-exposures.
This project builds deep learning methods that use imaging physics to rebuild and denoise MRI images.
This project studies how the immune system and cancer interact, and looks for ways to improve cancer immunotherapy and overcome resistance to it.
This project studies the neural circuits that control circadian activation of kisspeptin neurons, cells essential for the preovulatory surge.
This project builds a label-free molecular imaging method that maps biological and clinical samples at subcellular resolution using conventional mass spectrometry instruments.
This project studies how large double stranded DNA viruses package their DNA into a capsid shell using a terminase enzyme.
